sentences.text: This guy was so bad at math, he accidentally found two continents.
And he died refusing to admit he was lost.
Here's the myth: in 1492, people thought the Earth was flat.
Educated Europeans knew it was round, and roughly how big.
Columbus read an Arabic measurement, and used shorter Roman miles instead.
His Earth shrank by a quarter.
On his map, Japan sat just a few weeks west of the Canary Islands.
The royal experts checked his math, and said no.
Not because of a flat Earth.
Because his crew would starve in an empty ocean.
Except two continents nobody in Europe knew about were in the way.
He landed in the Bahamas, and called the people he met Indians.
Later, he made his crew swear that Cuba was part of Asia.
The worst math in history, and the luckiest wrong answer ever.
